SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT.title: Script
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT.descript: A special ongoing effect. Gaining another Script while you already have one ends the previous Script.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_DOOM_KILL_THRES: That enemy's HP minus its Poison, Burning, and Doom.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_STACKABLE_SCRIP: When you gain the same [gold]Script[/gold] again, it does not end the current [gold]Script[/gold]; stacks are added instead (upgraded effects are retained).
